threadDescriptions.junction-track: Lay and test model track at Marsh Junction
threadDescriptions.signal-control: Wire and program the Marsh Junction signals
threadDescriptions.marsh-scenery: Build the wetland scenery beside Marsh Junction
threadDescriptions.guitar-practice: Prepare a guitar arrangement for a friend's dinner

items.text: Marsh Junction: lay the passing loop before ballasting. The longest coach catches the platform edge on the inner curve.
items.rationale: Track clearance and construction at the junction.

items.text: Dinner guitar set: arrange the folk tune in G so I can sing the low verse. Ten minutes, no amplifier.
items.rationale: Personal music preparation.

items.text: Marsh signal board: output 7 drives the loop home signal. Red must show whenever the loop turnout points toward the siding.
items.rationale: Signal mapping and interlock behavior.

items.text: Wetland scenery samples: torn jute makes better reeds than the plastic grass. Test the ochre wash on scrap before doing the marsh bank.
items.rationale: Materials experiment for model landscape.

items.text: Loop curve trial uses radius 310 mm. It fits inside the board outline; leave pins loose until the long coach test.
items.rationale: Provisional track geometry.

items.text: Bench test: output 7 is inverted. Green appears when the occupancy detector is covered. Swap the active-low setting, not the LED wires.
items.rationale: Diagnosis of signal-controller behavior.

items.text: Seven again. Check the little red bit before gluing.
items.rationale: Number and vague object do not establish which model task is intended.

items.text: Guitar recording: the change into the final chorus drags. Practise just those four bars slowly with the thumb keeping the beat.
items.rationale: Refines the dinner arrangement.

items.text: The 310 mm loop radius failed with the long coach. Re-lay Marsh's curve at 350 mm and shorten the straight by 40 mm; ignore the earlier pinned outline.
items.rationale: Explicit correction to the earlier track geometry.

items.text: Reed bed trial has a hard edge. Feather it with fine grass and leave two muddy gaps, like the reference sketch.
items.rationale: Scenery treatment for the wetland area.

items.text: Before fixing the Marsh loop, cut the detector gaps at both ends and solder feeders underneath. Then programme the signal controller to hold the home signal red while a coach bridges either gap; test that before ballast hides the joints.
items.rationale: Specifies track construction and dependent signal-control implementation.

items.text: Home signal test now stays red with the loop occupied. The siding route still needs its timeout shortened from five seconds to two.
items.rationale: Validation and timing adjustment for the signal system.

items.text: Marsh water pour: seal the bank first. A teaspoon of tinted medium leaked through the foam seam on the trial piece.
items.rationale: Landscape water-effect preparation.

items.text: Rename the scenery folder 'Wetland corner' to 'Marsh bank'. Keep the reed and water samples together under that name.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of the landscape work collection.

items.text: Long coach clears the revised loop in both directions. Mark the final sleepers in pencil before lifting the track for glue.
items.rationale: Acceptance and next construction step for the track.

items.text: For dinner, skip the instrumental repeat. My guitar arrangement runs thirteen minutes with it and the host asked for ten.
items.rationale: Adjusts the prepared performance to its duration.

items.text: Still a small gap on the left.
items.rationale: The fragment lacks a subject or identifying context.

items.text: Marsh bank dried clear. Add a thin brown wash at the reed roots; leave the centre of the water glossy.
items.rationale: Finishing work on the wetland scenery.

items.text: Saved the signal settings after the two-second timeout test. Power cycling no longer restores the inverted output.
items.rationale: Configuration persistence check for the signal controller.

items.text: Ballast along the Marsh passing loop is set. Run the short wagon through the turnout to check for stray grit before using the locomotive.
items.rationale: Final track construction and running test.
